prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, new_screen] Pet Desk Appearance Warmup Screen: Adds a dedicated transition screen right after waiting to signal that the desktop engine is launching the pet onto the screen.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_launch", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_launch": {"headline": "Launching Pet to Desktop", "body": "Preparing desktop graphics engine and companion behaviors...", "components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:launch_anim"}]}}
1: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Display Verification Tip: Displays an explanatory tip on the waiting screen showing users how to check the system tray if their pet does not immediately appear.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "If your pet does not appear on your screen after loading, check your system tray or taskbar icon.", "tip_delay_seconds": 15}}
2: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Screen Split Feature Showcase Redesign: Redesigns the choose_path screen into a clear side-by-side split layout detailing preset vs custom photo creation paths.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose How Your Desktop Companion Comes to Life", "body": "Select standard companion adoption or create a unique pet from photo upload."}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Customization Photo Quality Preview Flow: Introduces an inline photo verification and live pet generation preview step on the upload_photos screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:photo_quality_check", "style": "highlight"}]}}
4: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Two Column Companion Comparison: Changes the pick_friend layout to a side-by-side two-column view to compare starter pet traits.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Compare Companion Characters", "body": "Select your ideal companion character to start your adoption process."}}
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Sign-In Existing Pet Data Preservation Notice: Updates headline and body on the sign-in screen to explicitly state that signing in saves existing pets and prevents resets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Preserve Your Pet & Companion Progress", "body": "Creating or signing into your account locks in your pets so they never reset or get lost."}}
6: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Quick Command Overview Screen: Adds a post-onboarding guidance screen showing how to right-click, hide, control, and talk to the pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_quick_commands"], "new_quick_commands": {"headline": "How to Control & Interact with Your Pet", "body": "Right-click your companion on the desktop to open settings, start talking, or send your pet to the system tray.", "layout": "checklist"}}
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Engine Status Indicator on Waiting Screen: Adds progress tracking indicators and time estimates for background engine rendering while users wait.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Preparing rendering assets and spawning desktop pet..."}}
8: [home, notification] Desktop Launch Ready Alert Trigger: Enables readiness notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when their pet is ready to appear on desktop.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Your Companion is Ready to Explore Your Desktop!"}}
9: [finish, layout] Home Intro Spotlight Onboarding Complete View: Switches home_intro screen to a spotlight layout focusing on immediate desktop pet interaction.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Your Desktop Pet is Active!", "body": "Your companion is now roaming your desktop screen. Click to say hello!"}}

Valid copy update on the sign-in screen.
Valid addition of a post-home_intro guidance screen within onboarding.
